description: #272 with #276: an EP05 whose line breaker closes ahead of the pantographs (PantRequiresMain=Yes) and whose line contactors close only with its own converter running (LineContactorsInterlock=Converter, a variant of the .fiz made for the run) stands cold on track 1 of Stacja1 and gets the order to run the td/rozklad timetable, with the span without voltage of ep05_td_dead_section on its way. The pantographs go up only through the closed line breaker, so the AI has to close it first, then start the converter, and leave; under the dead wire the main circuit, and with it the converter, has no voltage; behind it the AI takes power again and stops at Przystanek.
